mapper.sql: select id, repair_no, machinery_id, machinery_code, machinery_name, repair_type, fault_description, repair_content, repair_cost, status, repairman_id, repairman_name, repair_date, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from dv_repair
mapper.select:
AND repair_no like concat('%', #{repairNo}, '%')
AND machinery_code like concat('%', #{machineryCode}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into dv_repair (repair_no, machinery_id, machinery_code, machinery_name, repair_type, fault_description, repair_content, repair_cost, status, repairman_id, repairman_name, repair_date, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{repairNo}, #{machineryId}, #{machineryCode}, #{machineryName}, #{repairType}, #{faultDescription}, #{repairContent}, #{repairCost}, #{status}, #{repairmanId}, #{repairmanName}, #{repairDate}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update dv_repair set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
